name: KK144 (Hubble)
blurb: KK144, an isolated dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: leda166137-hubble
story: A faint, lonely dwarf galaxy that holds unusually much hydrogen gas for its few stars. Hubble resolved its red giant stars to measure how far away it is.

claims.text: KK144 is an isolated low surface brightness dwarf irregular galaxy with a high HI-mass-to-stellar-mass ratio
Hubble program 14636 measured tip of the red giant branch distances to its galaxies
KK144 has a measured TRGB distance
